question: Which teachers have taught the student with the earliest transcript issuance? List the teacher details.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "transcripts" AS SELECT "transcript_id" AS "transcript_id", "student_id" AS "student_id", "date_of_transcript" AS "date_of_transcript", "attribute_value_transcript_details" AS "attribute_value_transcript_details" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "classes" AS SELECT "class_id" AS "class_id", "student_id" AS "student_id", "tid" AS "tid", "cd" AS "cd" FROM table_3;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "teachers" AS SELECT "teacher_id" AS "teacher_id", "detail_value" AS "detail_value", "prefix" AS "prefix", "suffix" AS "suffix" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH earliest AS (
  SELECT student_id, MIN(CAST(strptime(date_of_transcript, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f') AS TIMESTAMP)) AS earliest_transcript_ts
  FROM transcripts
  GROUP BY student_id
  ORDER BY earliest_transcript_ts ASC
  LIMIT 1
), student_teachers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.tid AS teacher_id
  FROM classes c
  JOIN earliest e ON c.student_id = e.student_id
)
SELECT 
  t.teacher_id,
  t.detail_value AS teacher_detail,
  t.prefix,
  t.suffix
FROM teachers t
JOIN student_teachers st ON t.teacher_id = st.teacher_id
ORDER BY t.teacher_id;
